Voat still lacks functionality that Reddit has, (Like filtering posts by flair) but at least I can expect to not run into any of the bullshit that goes on over there.

The subreddit is dead at the moment, but I'm basically using it as a backup in case Voat goes away. I still have collections of all the DeviantArt and ArtStation posts that have been made over the years, a Dreamworlds music playlist over on SoundCloud, and the annual Dreamworlds music playlists are always going to be up on the Dreamworlds Youtube Channel. In other words, Dreamworlds isn't going anywhere, but Voat might, so you can still find this place in some form if you know where to look.
